src: Liquid biopsy with cell-free DNA analysis identified the T790M resistance mutation after first-line TKI therapy.
Circulating tumour DNA was detected in plasma, and sequencing depth was sufficient for low-frequency variants.
The EML4::ALK fusion was confirmed by FISH with a break-apart probe.
note: '::' kept as written; FISH probe = đầu dò (decision 7)

src: An EGFR exon 19 deletion is a sensitizing mutation, whereas most exon 20 insertions confer primary resistance.

src: MET amplification and MET exon 14 skipping were detected, while KIT and ATM were wild-type.

src: Measurable residual disease was monitored by RT-qPCR in peripheral blood after transplantation.
A somatic mutation in TP53 and a germline variant in MLH1 were found in the same patient with Lynch syndrome.
Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue with a tumour cell content of at least 20% was required for DNA extraction.
